FireflyLantern.name: Lantern
FireflyLantern.description:
A light to shine the way, illuminating even the most palpable darkness.

When held, reveal the Aura of Pallets, Vault locations, and the closest Generator. Place your Lantern atop a Generator to reveal its Aura to your teammates.

beginner.whatItIs: A survivor light source of common rarity that exposes the aura of each pallet, vault spot, and the closest generator while carried. Setting it down on a generator shares that generator's aura signal with every teammate.
beginner.whyItMatters: Seeing where to vault or which generator to approach without guessing removes wasted time and dangerous missteps in the fog. Setting it on a generator also gives teammates a visible marker, which cuts down on the searching that wastes a trial.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it on maps that feel especially dark or when a survivor plays far from the group and needs independent navigation. It appears often in chests thanks to common rarity, making it a reliable default carry for anyone new to the game.

Item_Camper_AlexsToolbox.name: Alex's Toolbox
Item_Camper_AlexsToolbox.description:
A metal box containing mainly saws and vice grips of varying sizes but also other tools. Even though the content of this Toolbox is clearly aimed at destructive deeds, it can be used to repair various mechanical components as well.

18 charges.Increases repair speed by 10%.Unlocks the sabotage action.Increases sabotage speed by 100%.

Repairing a generator requires 90 charges.

Sabotaging a hook requires 6 charges.

beginner.whatItIs: A very rare toolbox packed with saws and grips that nudges repair speed upward while giving sabotage work a massive speed boost. Its comparatively small charge pool suits a playstyle centered on hook disruption rather than sustained generator grinding.
beginner.whyItMatters: The sabotage speed bonus makes destroying hooks dramatically faster, which is the core problem it solves for a hook-focused build. The repair speed bump is more modest, but every increment of speed helps when a killer is nearby.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when sabotage is the priority of the run, such as when a team wants to quickly destroy a hook before a rescue window closes. Its very rare rarity means it is a chest find worth saving for, and it fits well on a survivor whose role is to manage hooks and traps.

Item_Camper_AnniversaryToolbox.name: Anniversary Toolbox
Item_Camper_AnniversaryToolbox.description:
A toolbox that’s slightly explosive.

32 charges.Increases repair speed by 50%.Unlocks the sabotage action.Increases sabotage speed by 50%.Detonates a firework once depleted. Yay!

Repairing a generator requires 90 charges.

Sabotaging a hook requires 6 charges.

beginner.whatItIs: A common toolbox with equal boosts to repair and sabotage speed, ending its run with a burst of firework when the last charge is spent. The balanced stat spread makes it a flexible choice for survivors who split time between generators and hooks.
beginner.whyItMatters: Equal boosts to repairing and sabotaging make it a balanced option for survivors who handle both generators and hooks in the same pass. The firework on depletion is purely cosmetic but adds a small celebratory moment to an otherwise tense trial.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a build needs a single toolbox that covers both jobs without specialization. Its common rarity makes it one of the easier toolboxes to find, so it is a solid default for a survivor who wants one item to handle everything.

Item_Camper_BeigeMap.name: Scribbled Map
Item_Camper_BeigeMap.description:
Peering at the parchment, a path appears in your mind. Moments later, you feel lost again.

Press the Use Item Button to reveal auras of all pallets and vaults within 32 meters for 12 seconds.Using the secondary interaction creates a beam of light at the Survivor's location. Generators within 32 meters of the beam of light have their auras revealed.5 charges.

beginner.whatItIs: An uncommon map that briefly exposes the auras of surrounding pallets and vault spots when its primary button is pressed. A secondary beam interaction also lights up any generator auras along the beam's path.
beginner.whyItMatters: Seeing pallet and vault locations in the dark lets a survivor plan an escape route or find a shortcut without stumbling around blindly. The secondary beam of light also reveals nearby generator Auras, which helps a team locate their next target quickly.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when navigation is the main challenge, such as on a map with complex geometry or when a survivor tends to get lost. Its uncommon rarity means it is less common than a standard map but still findable in chests, and it works well on any survivor who needs orientation.

Item_Camper_BrokenKey.name: Broken Key
Item_Camper_BrokenKey.description:
The bow and shank of a key, vibrating with power.


Consume a charge to:

Reveal auras of Survivors within 48 meters for 8 seconds by holding the Use Item Button.


Begins with 6 charges.

beginner.whatItIs: Broken Key is a common key that, when held, briefly reveals the auras of nearby survivors. Its limited charge pool supports several reveals across a full trial.
beginner.whyItMatters: Knowing where teammates are in the dark prevents accidental hook interference and lets a survivor coordinate a rescue or a generator push without relying on chat. It is a simple, low-risk tool that costs nothing to set up and carries no mechanical penalty.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a team plays spread out and needs a way to stay aware of each other's positions without calling out constantly. It is common rarity, so it is easy to find and a sensible carry for any survivor who wants situational awareness of the group.

Item_Camper_CommodiousToolbox.name: Commodious Toolbox
Item_Camper_CommodiousToolbox.description:
A large metal box containing basic tools and extra mechanical parts. Even without training, can be used to repair or break various mechanical components.

32 charges.Increases repair speed by 50%.Unlocks the sabotage action.Increases sabotage speed by 50%.

Repairing a generator requires 90 charges.

Sabotaging a hook requires 6 charges.

beginner.whatItIs: Commodious Toolbox is a rare toolbox that accelerates both generator repairs and hook sabotage at the same rate. Its generous charge pool easily covers multiple generator pushes or an entire round of hook work.
beginner.whyItMatters: The balanced split between repairing and sabotaging means a single survivor can handle both without swapping items, which is useful on maps where hooks and generators sit close together. The charge pool is large enough that it rarely runs out before a trial ends.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it on a survivor whose role is to keep generators moving and hooks managed in the same pass. Its rare rarity makes it a slightly harder find than common toolboxes, but the all-round performance keeps it a dependable choice for a well-rounded build.

Item_Camper_ContaminationSerum.name: Vaccine
Item_Camper_ContaminationSerum.description:
A vaccine effective against contamination from the T-Virus.

Limited items are consumed by The Entity at the trial's end.

beginner.whatItIs: Vaccine is a common protective item that shields a survivor from T-Virus contamination, a hazard that builds up in certain trial settings. The Entity claims it once the trial concludes, just like any other limited item.
beginner.whyItMatters: Without it, a survivor caught by T-Virus contamination has no way to protect against whatever penalty the contamination applies during that trial. Having the vaccine ready removes that risk entirely, so the survivor does not have to worry about managing the hazard on top of everything else.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it whenever a trial involves T-Virus hazards, such as specific event maps or special game modes that introduce contamination. It is common rarity and consumed at the end of the trial, so there is no long-term cost to carrying it as insurance.

Item_Camper_DullKey.name: Dull Key
Item_Camper_DullKey.description:
A bent and dull Key that once held great power.


Consume a charge to:

Reveal auras of Survivors within 56 meters for 9 seconds by holding the Use Item Button.Unlock Chests quickly. Chests unlocked with this Key have a revealed aura within 42 meters, enabling another Survivor to rummage once, and will contain items of at least Rare quality.Unlock the Hatch.


Begins with 5 charges.

beginner.whatItIs: An uncommon key that combines several distinct functions: briefly revealing other survivors' auras, unlocking chests at a quick pace with a rare-or-better guaranteed drop, and opening the exit hatch. Each action draws from the same small charge pool.
beginner.whyItMatters: The hatch unlock is the headline feature, since it lets a survivor who reaches the hatch area with no other key still leave the trial. The chest aura and one-time rummage bonus also make it a strong find for a team that needs extra items late in a game.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a survivor is likely to be near the hatch at the end of a trial or when the team has no guaranteed key carrier. Its uncommon rarity makes it less common than a standard key but still findable, and it fills multiple roles at once.

Item_Camper_EngineerToolbox.name: Engineer's Toolbox
Item_Camper_EngineerToolbox.description:
Metal box with highly specialized tools meant for engineering. Most of the tools can still be used by neophytes to make fast repairs or break various mechanical components.

16 charges.Increases repair speed by 100%.Unlocks the sabotage action.Increases sabotage speed by 10%.

Repairing a generator requires 90 charges.

Sabotaging a hook requires 6 charges.

beginner.whatItIs: Engineer's Toolbox is a very rare toolbox of specialized engineering tools that sharply accelerates generator repair while giving sabotage only a minor speed bump. Its modest charge pool suits quick, focused generator sprints.
beginner.whyItMatters: The repair speed bonus is substantial, making it well suited for a survivor whose entire role is keeping generators advancing quickly. The sabotage bonus is more modest, so a hook-focused build would get less value from it compared to a dedicated gen-rush survivor.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Place it on a survivor whose job is to clear generators fast and rotate, since its heavy repair bonus far outpaces the sabotage contribution. Chests are the usual source for a very rare drop, so prioritize picking it up early and saving its limited charges for the largest repair push available.

Item_Camper_FadedMap.name: Cryptic Map
Item_Camper_FadedMap.description:
Looking at it, the directions make no sense. But merely holding it grants you an uncanny intuition.

Press the Use Item Button to reveal auras of all pallets and vaults within 24 meters for 10 seconds.Using the secondary interaction creates a beam of light at the Survivor's location. Generators within 32 meters of the beam of light have their auras revealed.4 charges.

beginner.whatItIs: Cryptic Map is a common map whose primary action briefly reveals the auras of nearby pallets and vault spots. A secondary beam highlights generators in the surrounding area, helping to locate work from afar.
beginner.whyItMatters: The pallet and vault reveal helps a survivor find escape routes in the dark without wasting time searching blindly. The generator beam is a useful bonus for a team that needs to locate their next target without a full map reveal.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a survivor tends to get disoriented on dark maps or when the team needs a quick way to find the next generator. It is common rarity, so it is one of the easier maps to find and a sensible default carry for orientation.

Item_Camper_Firecracker_Anniversary2019.name: Third Year Party Starter
Item_Camper_Firecracker_Anniversary2019.description:
A small, highly-explosive dinner table decoration. Detonates into loud bangs, intense light flashes, and playful confetti. Can be used as a distraction, as a blinding device or to celebrate our three years together.

1 charge.

beginner.whatItIs: Third Year Party Starter is a common firecracker styled as a dinner table decoration that pops with a sharp bang, a burst of light, and a scatter of confetti. It doubles as a quick distraction or a brief blind for the killer, though many survivors simply enjoy the spectacle.
beginner.whyItMatters: The light flash can blind a killer mid-chase, buying a survivor extra seconds to reach a pallet or vault. The confetti is purely cosmetic and adds a small celebratory note to the distraction, while the loud bang draws the killer's attention to a specific spot.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it as a chase escape tool when a survivor wants a one-time blinding burst without carrying a full flashlight. It is common rarity and single-use, so it is best saved for a moment when a killer is actively in pursuit.

Item_Camper_Firecracker_Chinese.name: Chinese Firecracker
Item_Camper_Firecracker_Chinese.description:
A row of small explosive devices wrapped in heavy paper casing. Detonates into loud bangs and intense light flashes. Can be used as a distraction, as a blinding device or to celebrate.

1 charge.

beginner.whatItIs: Chinese Firecracker is a common firecracker consisting of small charges wrapped in thick paper, popping into a sharp bang and a flash of bright light. It serves as a quick distraction or a way to blind the killer mid-chase.
beginner.whyItMatters: The bright flash is the functional effect, capable of blinding a killer for a short window that lets a survivor break line of sight or reach cover. The loud bang also acts as a distraction, pulling the killer's attention toward the sound's location.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it as a simple, single-use blind for a survivor who does not want to commit to a full flashlight build. It is common rarity and easy to find, making it a low-cost emergency tool for a chase moment.

Item_Camper_Firecracker_Flashbang.name: Flash Grenade
Item_Camper_Firecracker_Flashbang.description:
A hand grenade that creates a large flash of light and a loud sound on detonation.

Limited items are consumed by The Entity at the trial's end.

beginner.whatItIs: Flash Grenade is a common firecracker shaped like a hand grenade that bursts into a wide flash of light along with a loud bang on detonation. It works as a chase-breaking blind, a distraction, or just a way to mark a spot with noise.
beginner.whyItMatters: The wide flash covers a lot of ground, which makes the blind harder for a killer to sidestep compared to a narrower one. Like other limited items, it disappears once the trial ends, so it is worth using rather than losing for nothing.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a survivor wants a wide, reliable blind in a single use, such as to break a chase in a tight corridor. It is common rarity and limited, so save it for a moment when a blind is truly needed rather than wasting it early in a trial.

Item_Camper_Firecracker_WinterEvent.name: Winter Party Starter
Item_Camper_Firecracker_WinterEvent.description:
A small, highly-explosive dinner table decoration. Detonates into loud bangs and intense light flashes. Can be used as a distraction, as a blinding device or to celebrate.

1 charge.

beginner.whatItIs: Winter Party Starter is a rare firecracker styled as a small tabletop decoration that bursts with a sharp report and a bright flash. It serves as a distraction, a blind, or a simple celebration for whoever is carrying it.
beginner.whyItMatters: The light flash can blind a killer and buy a survivor time to escape, while the loud bang draws attention to a specific spot. Its rare rarity makes it slightly harder to find than common firecrackers, so it is a better find when it appears in a chest.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Suit it for a survivor who wants a single blind without the upkeep of a flashlight. Its rare drop rate means chest hunters will encounter it less often than the common alternatives, so treat each find as a small upgrade to the loadout.

Item_Camper_Flashlight.name: Flashlight
Item_Camper_Flashlight.description:
A standard Flashlight. Can be used to light your way in the darkness.

8 seconds of use.

beginner.whatItIs: An uncommon handheld light that projects a focused beam to blind a killer and cut through the dark. The battery runs for a limited stretch, so each use shortens the window before the light goes dark.
beginner.whyItMatters: The blind effect is the core utility, letting a survivor break a chase or create an opening during a hook rescue. It has a limited battery, so the beam only lasts for a short period before it needs to cool down and be used again.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Load it onto a survivor who opens chases for the team, whether that means breaking a hook, baiting a hit, or escaping a corner. The battery is finite, so fire it in quick flicks and let it recharge rather than holding the beam down for long.

Item_Camper_Flashlight_Anniversary2020.name: Anniversary Flashlight
Item_Camper_Flashlight_Anniversary2020.description:
A festive Flashlight that explodes with confetti upon blinding a Killer. Surprise!

8 Seconds of use.

beginner.whatItIs: Festive lighting that fires a standard blind and bursts into a spray of confetti the moment the beam meets a killer. It is common rarity, and the light lasts a short stretch before the charge is spent.
beginner.whyItMatters: The blind itself works exactly like any standard flashlight, buying a survivor a few seconds to vault, heal, or peel off a hook. The confetti burst that follows is decorative only and does not change how the mechanic plays out.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Reach for it when a survivor wants a dependable blind with a festive flair and zero gameplay trade-off. Its common drop rate means it shows up in chests fairly often, making it a sensible default light for casual loadouts.

Item_Camper_Flashlight_Anniversary2022.name: Masquerade Flashlight
Item_Camper_Flashlight_Anniversary2022.description:
Not even a mask can protect you from this Flashlight's bright beam.

8 Seconds of use.Increases confetti by 100%.

beginner.whatItIs: Masquerade-themed lighting that delivers a standard blind and throws out a noticeably larger confetti burst when the beam strikes a killer. It is common rarity, and its light holds for a brief window before running out.
beginner.whyItMatters: The blind effect is the same as other common flashlights, so it fills the same role in a chase or rescue. The extra confetti is cosmetic and does not add any mechanical benefit beyond the visual effect of a bigger celebration.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a survivor wants a common rarity blind with a more noticeable cosmetic effect. It is as easy to find as any other common flashlight, so it is a good pick for anyone who wants the standard blind with a bit more celebration attached.

Item_Camper_Flashlight_Anniversary2026.name: Banquet Flashlight
Item_Camper_Flashlight_Anniversary2026.description: It’s time to burn calories...and retinas. 8 seconds of use.

beginner.whatItIs: A flashlight variant that projects an intense beam to distract or blind the killer. The burst of light lasts only a short time before the charge depletes.
beginner.whyItMatters: That brief blind window can break a chase or let a survivor vault to safety. The glow is intense enough to burn retinas, making it a high-impact tool that runs out with repeated use.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it on a chase-focused build where quick distractions matter most. Rare rarity means it may not appear in every trial's chest loot.

Item_Camper_Flashlight_Random.name: Flashlight
Item_Camper_Flashlight_Random.description: A Flashlight that can cause a distraction or even rescue another Survivor.

beginner.whatItIs: A flashlight item that shines a beam to create a distraction or open a window to rescue another survivor. The light is the sole tool for pulling the killer's attention away from a hook.
beginner.whyItMatters: The distraction it creates can pull the killer away from a downed teammate or interrupt an ongoing chase. Each swing of the beam depletes part of its limited supply.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a trial calls for aggressive rescue plays or when chase pressure needs a quick counter. It appears as a random chest find with no guaranteed rarity.

Item_Camper_Flashlight02.name: Sport Flashlight
Item_Camper_Flashlight02.description:
A very portable Flashlight with a good grip. Its efficient technology produces a powerful light while consuming less power.

8 Seconds of use.Decreases Flashlight battery consumption by 11%.Increases the accuracy of the Flashlight beam by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: Sport Flashlight is a compact, well-gripped flashlight that runs its battery longer than the standard model while keeping a tighter, more precise beam. Each flick lands sharper and is easier to aim during a chase.
beginner.whyItMatters: The improved accuracy makes it easier to actually land a blind on a moving killer, reducing wasted charges. The more efficient battery means the light lasts slightly longer before running out, giving a bit more flexibility in when to use it during a chase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a survivor wants a flashlight that is forgiving to aim and lasts a little longer in a chase. Its rare rarity makes it a better find than the common or uncommon options, and it suits a survivor who values precision over raw brightness.

Item_Camper_Flashlight03.name: Utility Flashlight
Item_Camper_Flashlight03.description:
A sturdy but heavy Flashlight that packs a lot of power.

12 Seconds of use.Increases the brightness of the Flashlight beam by 30%.Increases Blindness duration by 15%.Decreases the accuracy of the Flashlight beam by 20%.

beginner.whatItIs: Utility Flashlight is a very rare, heavy flashlight that sacrifices beam precision for raw brightness and a longer stretch of usable light. The wider spread still lands a blind, but it covers more area than a tighter model.
beginner.whyItMatters: The increased brightness and longer blind duration make it more effective at stunning a killer, which is the core of its value. The wider beam means it is harder to aim precisely, so it rewards a survivor who uses it at close range or in open areas.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it on a survivor who plays aggressively and wants a long, impactful blind. Its very rare rarity makes it a prized chest find, and the trade-off of a less focused beam means it is best used when a killer is already in close pursuit rather than at range.

Item_Camper_Flashlight04.name: Will O' Wisp
Item_Camper_Flashlight04.description:
A Flashlight equipped with a special lens cover that adds an orange tint and a little ghost to the beam.

8 Seconds of use. Considerably increases Friendly Ghosts in your life.

beginner.whatItIs: Will O' Wisp is a rare flashlight with a special lens cover that tints the beam orange and floats a tiny ghost inside the light. Its blind performance matches a standard model; the lens is pure flavor.
beginner.whyItMatters: The functional effect is the same standard blind as other flashlights, so it serves the same chase-escape and rescue-aid roles without any mechanical trade-off. The orange tint and ghost are cosmetic and do not change how the blind works in practice.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick it up if a survivor wants a blind with a distinctive look and no mechanical cost. The rare drop rate means it shows up less often in chests, but the gameplay stays identical to any other standard light.

Item_Camper_JerryCan_Spring2025.name: Blood Can
Item_Camper_JerryCan_Spring2025.description:
The handle is slick, and blood wells between your fingers as you tighten your grip.Found when interacting with the Blood Pump. Required to carry the blood needed to repair Blood Generators.

Carry capacity of 40 liters.Produces a pool of blood when running.Generates distinct noises while being carried.Noises vary depending on movement speed and number of liters being carried.Blood leaks from the Blood Can when running or if it is left on the ground.Killers can stomp the Blood Can while on the ground, spilling more blood.Vanishes from the trial when empty.

beginner.whatItIs: The heavy canister of blood that a survivor must carry to repair Blood Generators. It is obtainable only by interacting with the Blood Pump, not from a chest.
beginner.whyItMatters: Without it, Blood Generators cannot be repaired at all, so it gates the entire trial objective. It also leaks while running, leaving noise trails that trade stealth for progress.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Grab it the moment the Blood Pump activates and carry it with careful pacing to limit the leak. Its iridescent rarity means it will not appear in a normal chest.

Item_Camper_K29InfectionRemover.name: First Aid Spray
Item_Camper_K29InfectionRemover.description:
A medication that helps reverse the effects of Uroboros infection.

Limited items are consumed by The Entity at the trial's end.

beginner.whatItIs: A spray medication that reverses the effects of a Uroboros infection on the survivor carrying it. It exists specifically to counter that killer's infection mechanic during a trial.
beginner.whyItMatters: Uroboros infection is a problem this spray exists specifically to counter, clearing its effects off whoever is carrying the spray. Like other limited items, it disappears once the trial ends, so it is meant to be used rather than saved forever.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when playing against Uroboros and stack multiple sprays from chests to cover the whole match. Common rarity makes them easier to find than rarer medical tools.

Item_Camper_Key.name: Skeleton Key
Item_Camper_Key.description:
A tarnished and crooked key, vibrating with ominous power.


Consume a charge to:

Reveal auras of Survivors within 64 meters for 10 seconds by holding the Use Item Button.Unlock Chests quickly. Chests unlocked with this Key have a revealed aura within 42 meters, enabling another Survivor to rummage once, and will contain items of at least Rare quality.Unlock the Hatch.


Begins with 6 charges.

beginner.whatItIs: The tarnished key that reveals survivor auras, unlocks chests quickly, and opens the hatch. Each of those actions consumes one of its limited charges.
beginner.whyItMatters: Unlocking the hatch ends the trial instantly for the whole team, which is the fastest possible escape. The chest-unlock speed boost and revealed chest aura also make coordination faster, but every use drains a charge until the item is gone.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Hold it hidden until the final generator is nearly complete, then spend it on the hatch to end the trial before the killer hooks a last survivor. Rare rarity makes it a lucky find worth saving.

Item_Camper_Key_Random.name: Skeleton Key
Item_Camper_Key_Random.description: A Key that can unlock the hatch.

beginner.whatItIs: It serves as a key that opens the exit hatch, ending the trial for every survivor who reaches it in time. Unlike the rarer variant, it has a single focused purpose.
beginner.whyItMatters: The hatch is the fastest escape route in a trial, so carrying it means the team can leave before the killer finishes hooking the last survivor. The key is consumed the moment the hatch opens.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Save it for the endgame when most generators are complete and the hatch becomes the winning move. It appears as a random chest drop with no fixed rarity.

Item_Camper_LunarToolbox.name: Festive Toolbox
Item_Camper_LunarToolbox.description:
A Toolbox packed to the brim with fireworks, it's prepared to celebrate all your life’s successes... and failures.

32 charges.Increases repair speed by 50%.Unlocks the sabotage action.Increases sabotage speed by 50%.Great Skill Checks detonate a small cluster of firecrackers.Failed Skill Checks detonate fireworks.

Repairing a generator requires 90 charges.

Sabotaging a hook requires 6 charges.

beginner.whatItIs: The toolbox that speeds up generator repairs and unlocks the sabotage action on hooks. A firework-themed skin wraps the same core function, with a moderate charge pool backing it.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster repairs and the ability to break hooks gives a team more tempo and more hook-frees across a trial. Each repair and sabotage burns charges, so it runs out under sustained use.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it on repair-focused builds where breaking hooks and rushing generators matters most. Common rarity means it drops often enough to carry without much thought.

Item_Camper_Map_Random.name: Cryptic Map
Item_Camper_Map_Random.description: A Map that can reveal the aura of various objects.

beginner.whatItIs: It reveals the auras of various objects around the survivor who holds it, cutting down the need to search blindly. A general awareness of the surrounding area makes route planning easier.
beginner.whyItMatters: Knowing where pallets, generators, and other survivors are without being in close range helps a team coordinate. It cuts down wasted running between objectives early in a trial.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Carry it when a team needs a broad read of the map without committing to a specific object type. It drops from chests without a rarity label, so treat it as a flexible early-trial scouting option before a more focused tool arrives.

Item_Camper_Map_Spring2024.name: Bloodsense Map
Item_Camper_Map_Spring2024.description:
A bloodstained piece of parchment, hastily rolled and burning with a strange power.

Press the Use Item Button to reveal auras of all pallets, vaults and injured Survivors within 48 meters for 14 seconds.Using the secondary interaction creates a beam of light at the Survivor's location. Generators within 32 meters of the beam of light have their auras revealed.Causes pools of blood to spawn beneath you while being used.8 charges.

beginner.whatItIs: It reveals auras of pallets, vaults, and injured survivors in a wide area around the carrier. A secondary action projects a beam of light that exposes nearby generators.
beginner.whyItMatters: That wide reveal window lets a survivor find injured teammates, locate escape routes, or pinpoint the next generator without staying exposed for long. It also leaves blood pools behind as a small tracking risk while active.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it when the team is scattered and needs to regroup, or when searching for a downed survivor in a dense area. Rare rarity makes it a solid find to save for a critical moment.

Item_Camper_MechanicsToolbox.name: Mechanic's Toolbox
Item_Camper_MechanicsToolbox.description:
Metal box with specialized mechanics tools. Even without training, can be used to repair or break various mechanical components.

16 charges.Increases repair speed by 75%.Unlocks the sabotage action.Increases sabotage speed by 25%.

Repairing a generator requires 90 charges.

Sabotaging a hook requires 6 charges.

beginner.whatItIs: Metal box of specialized tools that increases repair speed significantly and unlocks hook sabotage with a modest speed boost. Its charge pool is smaller than what common toolboxes offer.
beginner.whyItMatters: The strong repair bonus shaves real time off each generator, which adds up across a full match. The lower charge count means it can run dry before a long trial ends if the team leans on it heavily.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Carry it on builds that prioritize fast generator completion and occasional hook breaks. Rare rarity makes it a meaningful upgrade over common toolboxes when found.

Item_Camper_MedKit.name: Camping Aid Kit
Item_Camper_MedKit.description:
A rudimentary aid kit which can save lives in emergencies, even if it's lacking some of its supplies.

24 charges.Increases the speed that you heal others by 35%.Unlocks the self-healing action.Decreases the speed and efficiency when healing yourself by 33%.

A full heal requires 16 charges.

beginner.whatItIs: Rudimentary aid kit that speeds up healing of other survivors and unlocks the self-healing action. Self-healing works slower and less efficiently than healing a teammate.
beginner.whyItMatters: The ability to heal teammates faster and to patch up after a chase makes it the core survival tool for a support-oriented build. Its charges drain with every heal until the kit is empty.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it whenever a trial needs a dedicated healer. Common rarity means it shows up in chests regularly and pairs well with any survivor who can protect a hook or generator.

Item_Camper_Medkit_Anniversary2020.name: Anniversary Med-kit
Item_Camper_Medkit_Anniversary2020.description:
A festive Med-kit that explodes with confetti upon fully healing a Survivor. Surprise!

24 charges.Increases the speed that you heal others by 40%.Unlocks the self-healing action.Decreases the speed and efficiency when healing yourself by 33%.Increases confetti by 100%.

A full heal requires 16 charges.

beginner.whatItIs: Festive medkit that delivers a standard healing speed boost for teammates and unlocks self-healing. A confetti burst fires when a full heal completes, purely as a cosmetic flourish.
beginner.whyItMatters: The healing numbers are solid for a common-rarity find, and the confetti effect adds no mechanical weight. The real value is in the reliable heal speed for a support role, with charges draining as expected.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it as a dependable healing option on any support build. Common rarity means it shows up often enough in chests to carry without hesitation.

Item_Camper_Medkit_Anniversary2022.name: Masquerade Med-Kit
Item_Camper_Medkit_Anniversary2022.description:
A festive Med-Kit with a shocking surprise, giving a whole new meaning to the term "health scare."

24 charges.Increases the speed that you heal others by 40%.Unlocks the self-healing action.Decreases the speed and efficiency when healing yourself by 33%.Increases confetti by 100%.

A full heal requires 16 charges.

beginner.whatItIs: Festive medkit with a surprising cosmetic effect that provides a standard healing speed boost for teammates. The self-healing unlock works the same as on other basic kits.
beginner.whyItMatters: The healing performance is comparable to other common medkits, so the value is in reliable support healing. Each full heal draws down the limited charge supply until the kit runs dry.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Carry it as a straightforward healing option when nothing better drops. Common rarity makes it an easy pick for any build that needs a patch in a hurry.

Item_Camper_Medkit_Anniversary2026.name: Banquet Med-Kit
Item_Camper_Medkit_Anniversary2026.description:
Does it heal indigestion? There’s only one way to find out.

24 charges.Increases the speed that you heal others by 40%.Unlocks the self-healing action.Decreases the speed and efficiency when healing yourself by 33%.

A full heal requires 16 charges.

beginner.whatItIs: Banquet Med-Kit is a rare medkit that makes healing an injured teammate noticeably quicker while also letting the carrier mend their own wounds at a reduced pace. Each use drains the charge pool, so plan carefully how to spend it.
beginner.whyItMatters: A solid healing speed boost makes it a strong choice when a trial demands fast rescues. It still drains charges with every full heal until empty.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it on healer builds that want a reliable patch without the visibility or self-heal trade-offs of other special kits. Rare rarity makes it a good find to save for a serious match.

Item_Camper_MedKit_Random.name: Camping Aid Kit
Item_Camper_MedKit_Random.description: A Medkit that can heal others faster or yourself.

beginner.whatItIs: Camping aid kit that heals other survivors at increased speed and also allows the carrier to heal themselves. Self-healing comes with a speed and efficiency penalty compared to healing a teammate.
beginner.whyItMatters: The dual healing capability means one survivor can patch teammates and still recover from their own injuries without waiting for help. The kit drains charges with every heal until empty.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Carry it on any build where healing is part of the role. It drops from chests with no fixed rarity and is the baseline medical tool to look for early in a trial.

Item_Camper_MedKit02.name: First Aid Kit
Item_Camper_MedKit02.description:
A standard first aid kit with all the necessary equipment for treating common to more serious injuries.

24 charges.Increases the speed that you heal others by 40%.Unlocks the self-healing action.Decreases the speed and efficiency when healing yourself by 33%.

A full heal requires 16 charges.

beginner.whatItIs: Standard medkit with a slightly stronger healing boost for teammates than the basic kit. It includes the same self-healing unlock with its slower trade-off.
beginner.whyItMatters: That extra healing speed matters most when multiple survivors need patching in quick succession, such as after a failed chase near a generator. It depletes with use like every other medkit.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it on healing builds where speed of rescue is the priority. Uncommon rarity puts it a step above the common camping kit without the higher cost of rarer options.

Item_Camper_MedKit03.name: Emergency Med-kit
Item_Camper_MedKit03.description:
A sturdy and well organized medical kit equipped with top condition emergency supplies.

24 charges.Increases the speed that you heal others by 45%.Unlocks the self-healing action.Decreases the speed and efficiency when healing yourself by 33%.

A full heal requires 16 charges.

beginner.whatItIs: Well-organized medical kit that provides a larger healing speed boost for teammates than the standard options. The self-healing action is available at its usual reduced efficiency.
beginner.whyItMatters: The stronger boost shortens the time a survivor spends vulnerable while being healed, which is critical in a chase or near a hook. The charge pool drains with each full heal.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Choose it for healer roles where a fast, reliable patch is the whole job. Rare rarity makes it a meaningful upgrade when it drops in a chest.

Item_Camper_MedKit04.name: Ranger Med-kit
Item_Camper_MedKit04.description:
A large metal box containing medical supplies aimed for emergency rescues in hard to reach, often isolated locations.

24 charges.Increases the speed that you heal others by 50%.Unlocks the self-healing action.Decreases the speed and efficiency when healing yourself by 33%.

A full heal requires 16 charges.

beginner.whatItIs: Large metal medkit designed for emergency rescues in isolated locations. It delivers a high healing speed boost for teammates while keeping the same self-healing trade-off as other kits.
beginner.whyItMatters: A strong healing speed bonus shortens the window a survivor is vulnerable while being patched up, which matters most when a rescue happens under killer pressure. The charge pool still drains with every full heal.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Save it for healer builds that want a fast, reliable patch under killer pressure. Very rare rarity makes it a lucky chest find worth prioritizing when it appears.

Item_Camper_Medkit05.name: All Hallows' Eve Lunchbox
Item_Camper_Medkit05.description:
A plastic lunchbox with phosphorescent Halloween stickers that has been packed with first-aid equipment.

24 charges.Increases the speed that you heal others by 40%.Unlocks the self-healing action.Decreases the speed and efficiency when healing yourself by 33%.Makes you considerably more visible.

A full heal requires 16 charges.

beginner.whatItIs: Plastic lunchbox with glowing Halloween stickers that functions as a medkit with a standard healing boost for teammates. It also unlocks self-healing and makes the carrier considerably more visible to the killer.
beginner.whyItMatters: The healing boost matches another medkit in the set, but the visibility penalty means the carrier stands out in the dark. It depletes with use like the others, so the trade-off is healing value versus staying hidden.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a team already has a strong chase or stealth perk covering for the visibility loss. The rare drop rate makes it a rewarding pick for a build willing to accept the extra glow.

Item_Camper_RainbowMap.name: Annotated Map
Item_Camper_RainbowMap.description:
The sketch is clear and detailed. Strange knowledge flows into you, followed by dread uncertainty.

Press the Use Item Button to reveal auras of all pallets and vaults within 40 meters for 14 seconds.Using the secondary interaction creates a beam of light at the Survivor's location. Generators within 32 meters of the beam of light have their auras revealed.6 charges.

beginner.whatItIs: Annotated Map is a rare survivor map that reveals the auras of nearby pallets and vaults the instant it is activated, making escape routes easier to read. A separate interaction projects a beam of light from the carrier's position to expose generator auras in that area.
beginner.whyItMatters: The pallet and vault reveal helps a survivor plan escape routes quickly without wandering blind. The beam action adds a generator-finding tool, but each use burns one of its limited charges.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it when navigating an unfamiliar map or when the team needs to coordinate generator order. Rare rarity makes it a worthwhile find to hold for a critical navigation moment.

Item_Camper_Toolbox.name: Toolbox
Item_Camper_Toolbox.description:
Metal box containing a set of basic tools. Even without training, can be used to repair or break various mechanical components.

20 charges.Increases repair speed by 50%.Unlocks the sabotage action.Increases sabotage speed by 15%.

Repairing a generator requires 90 charges.

Sabotaging a hook requires 6 charges.

beginner.whatItIs: A metal case of basic tools that a survivor carries into the trial. It speeds up generator repairs and also unlocks the ability to sabotage hooks.
beginner.whyItMatters: Repair speed matters because every second spent working a generator is a second the killer is hunting. The sabotage action gives a survivor a way to turn an occupied hook into a delayed trap, stalling a killer who expects to dump an injured teammate and move on. It runs out with use, so a long trial can exhaust the charge pool before every hook is dealt with.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a survivor wants a steady repair role that also covers hook sabotage. It is uncommon, so it shows up often enough to plan a build around. Each use drains the charge pool, so save it for the hooks that actually matter.

Item_Camper_Toolbox_Anniversary2022.name: Masquerade Toolbox
Item_Camper_Toolbox_Anniversary2022.description:
A Toolbox with all of the standard gadgets: wrenches, screwdrivers, fireworks, a hammer...

32 charges.Increases repair speed by 50%.Unlocks the sabotage action.Increases sabotage speed by 50%.Detonates a firework once depleted. Yay!

Repairing a generator requires 90 charges.

Sabotaging a hook requires 6 charges.

beginner.whatItIs: A toolbox loaded with wrenches, screwdrivers, fireworks, and a hammer. It speeds up generator repairs and hook sabotage, and once its charges run dry it detonates a firework as a small farewell.
beginner.whyItMatters: The higher sabotage speed matters most when a killer is trying to dump an injured survivor on a hook and move on to the next target. Unlocking sabotage at all turns a hook from a one-way trap into a two-way street, because a survivor can now undo the work. It is common, so it appears frequently enough to be a reliable part of a repair build.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a survivor wants both repair and sabotage coverage in a single slot, especially on maps with many hook locations. It is common, so it is easy to find in the locker. Once the last charge is spent, the toolbox detonates a firework.

Item_Camper_Toolbox_Anniversary2026.name: Banquet Toolbox
Item_Camper_Toolbox_Anniversary2026.description:
Nothing settles the stomach like manual labor.

32 charges.Increases repair speed by 50%.Unlocks the sabotage action.Increases sabotage speed by 50%

beginner.whatItIs: A toolbox tuned for steady repair work and hook sabotage in equal measure. It boosts repair speed and grants a faster sabotage action than the standard Toolbox.
beginner.whyItMatters: The higher sabotage speed means a survivor can work a sabotaged hook quickly and get away before the killer reacts. Combined with the standard repair boost, it covers both the fixing and the breaking sides of a repairer role. It is rare, so it does not show up as often as the common options.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a survivor wants a clean, no-frills repair and sabotage tool without any extra effects. It is rare, so it rewards patience in the locker. The charge pool is the same size as the Masquerade Toolbox, so it lasts through a full trial of hook work.

Item_Camper_Toolbox_Random.name: Toolbox
Item_Camper_Toolbox_Random.description: A Toolbox that can repair faster or sabotage hooks.

beginner.whatItIs: It is a toolbox variant with a random bonus. Depending on the roll, a survivor gets either a faster repair speed or a faster sabotage speed.
beginner.whyItMatters: The random element means a survivor never knows which half of the toolbox they will get, which adds a layer of uncertainty to the repair role. If the roll favors sabotage, it pairs well with a support build focused on hooks. If it favors repair, it works as a straightforward repairer tool.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a survivor is comfortable with a gamble and does not mind whichever bonus comes up. It has no rarity listed, so it is unlikely to be a reliable drop. Treat it as a wildcard that might help or might underwhelm.

Item_Camper_VoidBomb_Halloween2024.name: Void Crystal
Item_Camper_VoidBomb_Halloween2024.description:
Cold to the touch, the crystal vibrates from the force contained within.1 charge.

When shattered, the Void Crystal releases thick smoke with an expanding radius of up to 4 meters.Survivors within 6 meters of the smoke do not leave scratch marks.The smoke dissipates 8 seconds after reaching it maximum size.

beginner.whatItIs: The Void Crystal is a firecracker that, when shattered, releases a thick cloud of smoke. Survivors standing inside the smoke leave no scratch marks on the ground.
beginner.whyItMatters: Scratch marks are how a killer spots a survivor trail after a chase, so erasing them for a moment can be the difference between a clean escape and a re-chase. The smoke also gives a brief window for a survivor to slip past the killer line of sight. It has a single use, so once it is shattered the effect is gone for the rest of the trial.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it at the end of a chase when a survivor needs to stop leaving scratch marks behind. It is common, so it appears often enough to be a reliable escape tool. Because it only works once, save it for the moment when a visible trail would otherwise lead the killer straight back.

Item_Camper_WornoutToolbox.name: Worn-out Tools
Item_Camper_WornoutToolbox.description:
Metal box containing out of condition tools that could break at any moment. Even without training, can be used to repair or break various mechanical components.

16 charges.Increases repair speed by 50%.Decreases Skill Check success zone size by 10%.Unlocks the sabotage action.

Repairing a generator requires 90 charges.

Sabotaging a hook requires 6 charges.

beginner.whatItIs: Worn-out Tools is a metal box of tired, out-of-condition instruments. A survivor can still use them to repair generators and sabotage hooks, but the Skill Check zone is smaller than with a standard toolbox.
beginner.whyItMatters: The smaller Skill Check zone means a survivor must be more precise when working a generator, which adds tension to every repair. The upside is that it still unlocks the sabotage action and grants the standard repair speed boost. It is common, so it is an easy find in the locker.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a survivor wants a toolbox and is comfortable with a tighter Skill Check window. It shows up often enough to be a reliable find. The smaller success zone is a trade-off that rewards a steady, practiced repairer.

Item_FragileObject.name: Pocket Mirror
Item_FragileObject.description:
A pocket mirror pulled from the basement's White Glyph. Its surface is frosty.

Limited items are consumed by The Entity at the trial's end.

beginner.whatItIs: Pulled from the basement White Glyph, the Pocket Mirror has a frosty surface. It is a limited item, so The Entity consumes it at the end of the trial.
beginner.whyItMatters: The Pocket Mirror is a limited item, so it disappears the moment the trial ends. It carries no stated repair, healing, or evasion effect, making it a curiosity rather than a functional tool. A survivor who picks it up is holding a one-trial find with no gameplay bonus to speak of.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it only as a story fragment, since it carries no rarity listing and The Entity reclaims it the instant a trial closes. A survivor might feel drawn to its frosty surface, but no build should depend on something that vanishes when the entity takes back its space. It exists more as a fragment of narrative than as a survival aid.

Item_Survivor_CalamariContaminationAntid.name: Antidote
Item_Survivor_CalamariContaminationAntid.description: A potent formula that reverses the effects of both the T-Virus and Uroboros Infection. Limited items are consumed by The Entity at the trial's end.

beginner.whatItIs: Reversing both the T-Virus and Uroboros Infection, the Antidote is a potent formula a survivor carries into a trial. Because it is a limited item, The Entity takes it once the trial ends.
beginner.whyItMatters: Both the T-Virus and Uroboros Infection impose effects on a survivor that the Antidote can reverse. Carrying one means a survivor is not helpless once those conditions take hold. It is common, so it is reasonably easy to find in the locker.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it into any trial where the T-Virus or Uroboros Infection is in play, since it reverses both conditions. It is common, so a survivor can plan on finding one without needing a rare drop. It is a limited item, so it must be used within the trial in which it is found.

Item_Survivor_K044Artifact.name: Searcher's Pendant
Item_Survivor_K044Artifact.description:
An artifact from another place, where the night sky held answers.

Use Item button: Collect Exiled Souls.For each Exiled Soul collected (up to 10), gives an extra 0.5 seconds of Endurance, Haste, and Elusive when Liberated from Exile.Exiled Souls do not provide additional bonuses once all Generators are completed.

Limited items are consumed by The Entity at the trial's end.

beginner.whatItIs: Searcher's Pendant is a common survivor item carried out of a place where the night sky held answers. Holding the Item button gathers Exiled Souls, and each one banked stretches the Endurance, Haste and Elusive granted on being Liberated from Exile. Once every Generator is finished the souls stop adding anything, and The Entity takes the pendant when the trial ends.
beginner.whyItMatters: Each Exiled Soul collected adds a small boost to Endurance, Haste, and Elusive the moment a survivor is Liberated from Exile. The more souls collected, the stronger that short window of enhanced stats becomes. Once all generators are complete, the souls stop providing bonuses, so the value is front-loaded in the trial.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a survivor expects to face Exile, since the bonus only activates upon Liberation from Exile. It is a common drop, so no rare luck is needed to find one. Collect Exiled Souls across the map before the final generators finish, because the bonus stops stacking the moment all of them are complete.

Item_Survivor_K41Mushroom.name: Glowing Fungus
Item_Survivor_K41Mushroom.description:
A mushroom that decreases Leeched over time.

Limited items are consumed by The Entity at the trial's end.

beginner.whatItIs: The Glowing Fungus is a mushroom that gradually reduces Leeched over time. It does not carry over between trials, since The Entity claims all limited items when a trial concludes.
beginner.whyItMatters: The Fungus decreases Leeched over time while a survivor carries it. It works passively, so no action is needed once it is picked up. It is common, so it is a reasonable find in the locker.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick it up when Leeched is chipping away at a survivor and they need a gradual recovery instead of an instant patch. It is a common drop, so finding one requires no rare luck. Because it is a limited item, it only works during the trial where it was found and is gone once the trial concludes.

Item_Survivor_MakeshiftFogVial.name: Apprentice's Fog Vial
Item_Survivor_MakeshiftFogVial.description:
Made by the hands of a diligent but timid novice.

Releases concentrated Fog.Fog Cloud lasts for 8 secondsFog Cloud expands to a maximum of 8 meters.While inside a Fog Cloud, auras are suppressed, and Survivors leave no scratch marks and make no sound.Has 4 charges.Recharges over 70 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Crafted by a diligent but timid novice, the Apprentice's Fog Vial releases a concentrated cloud of fog when thrown. While inside the cloud, a survivor leaves no scratch marks, makes no sound, and their auras are suppressed from the killer view.
beginner.whyItMatters: The fog cloud creates a temporary zone where a survivor is effectively hidden from the killer tracking tools, which is invaluable at the end of a chase. Suppressing auras means the killer cannot see the survivor through walls or generators from inside the cloud. It has multiple charges, so it can be used more than once in a trial, but each charge takes time to come back.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Throw it when a survivor is caught in the open and needs to vanish from killer tracking for a short window. It is a common item, so it does not require a rare find to equip. The recharge between uses is long enough to matter, so plan where each charge lands rather than spraying them in panic.

Item_Survivor_PrototypeFogVial.name: Artisan's Fog Vial
Item_Survivor_PrototypeFogVial.description: Crafted by an experienced glazier with a love for her craft.Releases concentrated Fog.Fog Cloud lasts for 10 secondsFog Cloud expands to a maximum of 8 meters.While inside a Fog Cloud, auras are suppressed, and Survivors leave no scratch marks and make no sound.Has 4 charges.Recharges over 65 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Crafted by an experienced glazier, the Artisan's Fog Vial releases a concentrated fog cloud that lasts longer than the Apprentice's version. Inside the cloud, a survivor is silent, leaves no scratch marks, and their auras are hidden.
beginner.whyItMatters: The longer fog duration gives a survivor extra breathing room to reposition, vault, or circle a pallet before the cloud burns out. It keeps the same multi-charge structure as the Apprentice's Fog Vial but refills between uses at a quicker pace. As an uncommon item, it is a step up from the common vial without requiring a rare find.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it when a survivor wants a slightly longer fog window without committing to the rarest drop. It is uncommon, so it is easier to find than the rare variant but less common than the Apprentice's. Use each charge when the fog would actually buy a survivor a clean escape rather than just a brief pause.

Item_Survivor_VigosFogVial.name: Vigo's Fog Vial
Item_Survivor_VigosFogVial.description: From the man’s own collection. Impeccable. Unparalleled.Releases concentrated Fog.Fog Cloud lasts for 12 secondsFog Cloud expands to a maximum of 8 meters.While inside a Fog Cloud, auras are suppressed, and Survivors leave no scratch marks and make no sound.Has 4 charges.Recharges over 60 seconds.

beginner.whatItIs: Vigo's Fog Vial is a rare survivor item that emits a pocket of dense fog when activated. While a survivor stands inside that fog, auras are suppressed, footsteps go silent, and no trail of scratches is left behind. The vial holds only a handful of charges and needs a break before it can be used again.
beginner.whyItMatters: The extra duration means a survivor has more time to work through a pallet loop or cross open ground while the killer tracking is suppressed. It recharges the fastest of the three, which matters in a long trial where every fog window counts. It is rare, so it is the hardest of the three to find in the locker.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Bring it when a survivor wants the most forgiving fog window and is willing to hunt for a rare drop. It is rare, so it does not appear as often as the common or uncommon versions. Save each charge for a moment when the fog would genuinely change the outcome of a chase rather than just delaying a hit.
